about.title: About BetterValenzuela
about.description: What BetterValenzuela is, how it relates to BetterGov.ph, and how to help.
about.lede: A volunteer-run civic tech project for Valenzuela City, and part of BetterGov.ph.
about.parent: BetterValenzuela is part of {link}, a volunteer-led civic tech community. It shares BetterGov’s mission and values.
about.mission1: BetterGov is a volunteer-led tech initiative committed to creating #civictech projects aimed at making government more transparent, efficient, and accessible to citizens.
about.mission2: Our goal is to support, promote, consolidate, and empower citizen builders!
about.goal1: Building a volunteer-run website that reflects Filipino values and culture
about.goal2: Open Source and Open Data projects for better collaboration
about.goal3: Creating intuitive navigation and search functionality
about.goal4: Ensuring accessibility for all citizens, including those with disabilities
about.goal5: Providing accurate, up-to-date information about government services
about.goal6: Establishing a model for how government digital services can and should work
about.provideIntro: To support citizen builders in building impactful civic tech projects:
about.provide1.d: Servers, AI credits, development tools, and more!
about.provide2.d: Regular events to collaborate and build together
about.provide3.d: Access to government data and API endpoints
about.provide4.d: Connect with the right people and resource persons
about.provide5.d: Guidance from seasoned tech and startup veterans
about.provide6.d: Physical workspace for collaboration and meetings
about.whyIntro: The current state of Philippine government websites, particularly the main portal {link}, presents numerous challenges for citizens:
about.why1: It would benefit from regular content updates to ensure citizens have access to the most current information and services.
about.why2: There's an opportunity to improve user navigation by reviewing and updating links, as well as streamlining pathways to help visitors find what they need more easily.
about.why3: Implementing consistent design standards and formatting across all pages could create a more cohesive and professional user experience.
about.why4: Enhancing accessibility features and overall user experience would make government services more inclusive and user-friendly for all citizens.
about.why5: These improvements could serve as a model for other government agency websites, creating a more unified and effective digital government presence.
about.whyOutro: These issues create barriers for citizens trying to access essential government services and information.
about.commit1: We're angry. You're angry. But we can contribute in our own ways — no matter how little it is.
about.commit2: We can do amazing things together. Grassroots style. Open source. No permission needed.
about.commit3: We are committed to putting time, resources, and money into this initiative. We will keep building relentlessly without anyone's permission. Open source, public, high quality sites.
about.commit4: WE'RE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE SMARTER THAN US!
about.license: BetterValenzuela’s code is released under the {mit} and its content under {cc}. You can reuse both, as long as you credit BetterValenzuela.
about.ctaText: Join our community of builders, dreamers, and changemakers.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: BetterValenzuela collects no personal information and uses no cookies.
privacy.g4: Forms that send data to us
privacy.p1: BetterValenzuela does not ask for, collect, or store any personal information. There are no accounts, no sign-up, and no forms that send data to us.
privacy.p2: We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to count page visits so we know which pages people use. It does not use cookies, does not track you across other sites, and does not tell us who you are. We only see totals, such as how many people opened the Hotlines page.
privacy.p3: When you tick documents on a requirements checklist, the ticks are saved in your own browser so they are still there next time. They never leave your device. Clearing your browser data removes them.
privacy.p4: “Report an error” opens a form on GitHub. Anything you write there is public and handled by GitHub under its own privacy statement. Please do not include personal information in reports.
privacy.p5: We link to official city pages and other sources. Those sites have their own privacy policies.
privacy.p6: We follow the spirit of the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173). Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to share, correct, or delete. Questions? {link}.
a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.description: BetterValenzuela is built to be usable by everyone, on any device.
a11y.intro: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA, and every page is checked automatically for accessibility problems before it goes live.
a11y.d1.d: Every page works with a keyboard, with a visible focus and a “Skip to main content” link.
a11y.d2.d: Clear headings, labeled buttons, and phone numbers announced as call links.
a11y.d3.d: Pages still work when you zoom up to 200% or use larger text.
a11y.d4.d: Text and buttons meet AA color contrast, and color is never the only signal.
a11y.d5.d: Animations turn off when your device asks for reduced motion.
a11y.d6.d: Pages load and read fine without scripts; only search and a few extras need them.
a11y.limits: Some official documents we link to, such as scanned PDFs on the city website, may not be accessible. We do not control those files, but we summarize the key information on our pages wherever we can.
a11y.ctaText: Tell us which page and what went wrong. We aim to reply within a week.
